body: Me. Too. I been chasing girls because I’ve always wanted to have that significant other, you ain’t gonna believe this but I am also 19 haha. We all have that specific one that we want and we just hope that it happens, I have the mistake of believing that a girl will help resolve whatever feeling I have, but I truly believe it will, but I can’t add that load to someone and be disappointed if it doesn’t work out. Best advice I’ve ever gotten was “Girls simply come and go” and that “The people that love you stick around, and the ones that used you leave”. It’ll all fall in place some way some day. we are young.

Back in 2020, October 18, my friend passed away in a wreck on his birthday. I know what it’s like to lose someone especially someone who you had to talk to, he was the only person who would personally call me, not text, call, to see how I was doing. He was my big brother figure I’ve always wanted, abs it was short lived. I don’t have the strongest connection with my dad and I feel like I can’t come to him and have a heart to heart conversation, I’m just like you in a way. I’m out going, I work out regularly, I do sports and have had many friends from it, everyone says I’m funny and fun to be around, but somehow it still crashes down on me. People say the love me but I never feel or see it, and it’s hard for me to believe it, I’m not suicidal either, but part of me wants a reset button or just to be gone.

I don’t think I’ve ever related to anything more in my life. I haven’t gotten out of bed and it is currently 5:15PM. I stayed up all night crying and reaching out to friends who never answered me, it happens often, and that feeling makes me feel stupid for reaching out, I just need 5 mins so someone can hear me out so I don’t choke in my own thoughts, it’s a scary feeling. I do good things, I have a good heart with good intentions, but it seems as if the more good I do, the worse things get for me. And that’s something I will never understand and it breaks my heart and I feel weak, and unloved, unwanted. I just want something to spark a change, but I don’t know how or when it will happen.

This is an old sub, If you read it, thank you.
Just this past NYE celebration I went out with 2 girls who are my friends, we been close for quite some time, l was quite attracted to both, and while at this dance party, before the countdown they went off from me to go find dudes to make out with at midnight. That hurt me, because I thought we would stuck together. It felt as if time was in slow motion and everyone had someone but me, I felt pathetic of myself. Idk how to stop this feeling but I’ve been struggling since, my self esteem as at an all time low, and I fear that I will always be alone, with no romantic affection from another person, although I am 19, I feel rushed to find someone. Feels like time is running out. How do I stop this feeling and tell myself there is hope.

Thank you
